title: thickener operation
description: A gravity thickener sized from the case's batch settling test by Kynch's construction. Model talmageFitch: the tangent at the declared compression time (Talmage & Fitch 1955 eqs. 7-10; Wills & Napier-Munn 2006 eq. 15.6). Model coeClevenger: the largest area over the layers of the test (Wills eq. 15.5). The area is the result; depth, compression zone and safety factor are not applied. Inlet in, outlets (underflow overflow).

settlingTest.title: Batch settling test
settlingTest.description: The interface height H against time t, first point t = 0, H = H_0. The lists are SI (s, m): a list carries no unit word.

initialConcentration.title: Initial concentration C_0
initialConcentration.description: kg of solids per m3 of slurry; the test should be run at the expected feed concentration.

height.title: Interface heights (m)
height.description: One per time; the first is H_0; the interface never rises.

underflowConcentration.title: Target underflow concentration C_u
underflowConcentration.description: Above C_0, below the solid's density, and within what the test reached (H_u = C_0 H_0 / C_u not below the last height).

compressionTime.title: Compression time t_c
compressionTime.description: The time at which the settling solids go into compression, read off the test: declared, never guessed (Perry 9th ed. p. 18-64). Required by talmageFitch; optional for coeClevenger, which then draws the tangent.
